products.name: SCCM Application Migration to Intune Win32 (Repackaging) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to migrate the SCCM application estate to Intune Win32 — inventory SCCM apps, repackage each into .intunewin with correct detection and assignments, run coexistence, and validate each before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Repackage your SCCM apps into Intune Win32 — and prove each one still deploys

Moving app delivery from Configuration Manager to Intune means every SCCM application — with its detection method, requirements, dependencies, and deployment types — has to be repackaged as an Intune Win32 app and validated so nobody loses software mid-migration. Done by hand it's slow and inconsistent. This solution gives you a repeatable way to migrate the SCCM application estate to Intune Win32: inventory the SCCM apps, repackage each into .intunewin with correct detection and assignments, run coexistence during transition, and validate each before cutover.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — mapping SCCM applications (deployment types, detection methods, requirements, dependencies) to Intune Win32 apps, the repackage-and-validate model, SCCM/Intune coexistence during migration, and the ringed cutover.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Configuration Manager access to export app metadata, the Win32 Content Prep Tool, source installers, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory SCCM apps and deployment types, prioritize, repackage each into .intunewin with detection/requirements/dependencies, recreate assignments, run coexistence, validate deployment, cut over by ring, retire the SCCM deployment, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SCCM-vs-Intune app inventory discovery, install/detection validation, a repackage-coverage and deployment-success report, safe remediation of failed installs, and an app-assignment ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Your SCCM application estate repackaged into Intune Win32 and proven to deploy — correct detection, requirements, and assignments, validated before cutover with SCCM coexistence — so no user loses software during the move, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SCCMAPP-Discovery.ps1 — inventory SCCM applications, deployment types, and detection methods
    • SCCMAPP-Remediation.ps1 — safely remediate a migrated Win32 app that failed to install
    • SCCMAPP-Report.ps1 — repackage coverage + Intune Win32 deployment-success report (Microsoft Graph)
    • SCCMAPP-Set-AppRingTargeting.ps1 — build the pilot/broad app-assignment ring groups (Graph)
    • SCCMAPP-Validation.ps1 — confirm a migrated app installed and its detection rule matches (parity)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
